title: What If the Hunga Tonga Eruption Happened Again?

scenes.text: What if the biggest eruption of this century happened again? The blast punched into the upper atmosphere.
The plume climbed 58 kilometers, two and a half times higher than any thunderstorm ever observed.
Within hours, the boom was heard as far as Alaska, and the pressure wave circled the planet twice.
A tsunami nearly 15 meters high destroyed villages, then spread to the coasts of Japan and the Americas.
Weeks later, the stratosphere held 13 percent more water vapor than normal, and aerosols rose fivefold.
The plume circled the whole Earth in one week. This was the largest eruption of the 21st century.

description:
What if the Hunga Tonga eruption happened again?
Its plume reached 58 kilometers, its pressure wave circled the Earth twice, and it loaded the stratosphere with water vapor.
